subject.title: Feature/Fix: Integrate lineage discovery and shadow accounting

question: Should CodexBar land the four-PR lineage-shadow architecture in order, or prefer the narrower fork identity and cache repair before adopting the larger accounting architecture?
rationale: Both paths address the same overcounting area with different scope and upgrade risk, so repository evidence cannot determine the intended permanent architecture or landing sequence.

options.title: Land lineage stack
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2155 through https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2158 in order after exact-head runtime proof and latency review.

options.title: Prefer narrow repair
options.body: Land or adapt https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118 first and pause the larger stack until remaining accounting gaps are measured.

options.title: Pause both paths
options.body: Keep legacy accounting unchanged while maintainers define one canonical scanner architecture and benchmark contract.

recommendation.title: Land lineage stack
recommendation.body: Review and land https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2155 through https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2158 in order after exact-head runtime proof and latency review.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner and likely final integration decision-maker, this person is best positioned to choose between the overlapping landing paths.
